title: Paid Time Off Policy
text:
Full-time employees get 20 PTO days per year. PTO requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.

Up to 5 unused days carry over into January. Carry-over balances expire on March 31.

title: VPN Setup Guide
text:
Connect to the corporate VPN using the GlobalConnect client. VPN access requires multi-factor authentication.

If the VPN disconnects repeatedly, restart the GlobalConnect client and clear cached credentials. If that fails, open an IT ticket.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
text: Expenses above 500 dollars need manager approval before purchase. Receipts must be uploaded within 30 days of the expense. Travel bookings must go through the corporate travel tool.

title: Salary Bands 2026
text: Engineer II salary band ranges from 140,000 to 175,000 dollars. Senior Engineer salary band ranges from 170,000 to 215,000 dollars. Band adjustments are reviewed every January.

title: Q3 Revenue Forecast
text: The Q3 revenue forecast is 48 million dollars. Cloud spend is projected to grow 12 percent quarter over quarter.

title: Production Deployment Runbook
text:
Production deployments happen on Tuesday and Thursday after 6pm Pacific. Every production deployment needs an approved change request.

Rollback steps must be tested in staging before the deployment window opens.
